screen.mcdisplays.display_panel.hint: Put a written book, book and quill, MineColonies resource scroll, or MineColonies clipboard into the slot.
mcdisplays.configuration.title: MC Displays Settings
mcdisplays.configuration.display.refresh:
How often MC Displays refreshes book, Resource Scroll, or Clipboard content.

20 ticks = 1 second.
mcdisplays.configuration.display.maxDisp: Maximum allowed width for one rectangular multiblock display, measured in panels.
Maximum allowed height for one rectangular multiblock display, measured in panels.
mcdisplays.configuration.display.allowMa:
If enabled, an empty main hand can turn pages on a display.

Right side advances, left side goes back. Sneak-right-click still removes the source item.
